analysis_refs.heading: Research matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **P04 Property, ownership records and land rights — C18** | County recorder/register of deeds, assessor/property appraiser, tax authority and cadastral GIS; [NYC ACRIS](https://www.nyc.gov/site/finance/property/acris.page) is an illustrative city record system | State revenue/registration portals discovered through [DILRMP](https://dilrmp.gov.in/) and [NGDRS state links](https://ngdrs.gov.in/NGDRS_Website/state_ut_links.php?lang=en); [Tamil Nadu land e-services](https://eservices.tn.gov.in/eservicesnew/index.html) is a first state case | Address, parcel/APN/BBL, survey/subdivision, village/tehsil, registration/document number → actual public record and issuing office. Separate owner field, assessment, tax bill, deed, record of rights and mutation. None alone becomes our independent certification of current legal title. |
